name: todolist
description: Connect agents to TodoList over MCP, with skills that teach the task methodology and hooks that enforce it.

mcp_url.title: TodoList MCP address
mcp_url.description: Copy it from TodoList, Settings > Agent keys, on the site you use. It ends in /api/mcp, or /api/mcp/readonly for read-only tools.

agent_key.title: Agent key
agent_key.description: An elk_ key created in Settings > Agent keys on the same site. Kept in your system's secure credential store.
